docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
docs.text: Below are some common questions and answers regarding CrystalEMR.

docs.title: Appointment Management
docs.text:
How do I create a new appointment?
  1. Go to the Appointments section.
  2. Click on New Appointment.
  3. Fill in patient details, date, and time.
  4. Click Save to confirm the appointment.
Can I reschedule or cancel an appointment?

Yes, you can reschedule or cancel an appointment by: - Navigating to the Appointments section. - Clicking on the appointment you wish to change. - Selecting Reschedule or Cancel.

docs.title: Billing & Payments
docs.text:
How do I generate an invoice?
  1. Go to the Billing section.
  2. Click New Invoice.
  3. Select the patient and add services or medicines.
  4. Click Generate Invoice.
What payment methods are supported?

CrystalEMR supports payments via: - Cash - Credit/Debit Cards - UPI (for supported regions)

docs.title: General Questions
docs.text:
How do I log in to CrystalEMR?

To log in, visit the login page and enter your credentials. If you forget your password, click on Forgot Password? to reset it.

How can I reset my password?

If you forgot your password, click on Forgot Password? on the login page. Enter your registered email address and follow the instructions sent to your email.

What are the minimum system requirements for using CrystalEMR?

CrystalEMR works on modern web browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. For the best experience, we recommend using Google Chrome on a device with at least 4GB of RAM.

docs.title: Token Creation
docs.text:
What are toknes? Why are they required

Tokens are basically arrival time stamps and patients are arrived into the OPD by creating a token each time they come for OPD. They are required to keep track of arrival time and the time spent by patient in the OPD/OT on that day. It’s a very essential OPD tool for patient management. Note: This is often confused with Patient ID/MRD Number. Please note Patient ID is constant once generated. Token number is different for each visit of patient, as token is generate per visit.

How do I Create a blank token and assign patient to a blank token?

  1. Creating a Blank Token :

    • On home-screen of Crystal App, press on NEW TOKEN button.\n
    • A pop-up window will appear, press on YES to create new token.\n
    • Blank token will be visible on home screen.\n

  2. Assigning Patient to Blank Token:

    • Select newly created blank token
    • 'Search Contact' window will appear
    • For existing patient, search the name and select the patient.
    • For new Patient press on " + " symbol on top right, enter Name and mobile number.
    • Save the details.
What is check in and check out? 
- Check-in Time   = Time of token generated
- Check-out Time= Time of patient leaving the clinic
Once Token is made, can we cancel it? and how to hide it from the home screen? will it be counted towards total token count? 
Once the token is made, we cannot delete it.

Tokens cannot be Cancelled.

In case of assigned tokens, just Checkout the token.

In case of blank token, nothing can be done. In both case, apply filter "Active tokens only" 
to hide blank tokens and check-out tokens..

Yes, in unfiltered view, that token will be counted.

For more details, visit our Support Page.

docs.title: Appointment App
docs.text: Introduction   Appointments App is a multi-branch and multi-consultant application. Based on the selected branch, each consultant has a predefined unique consultation time range.   Table of Contents Add Widget  Widgets provide a direct shortcut to a specific consultant, making appointment booking easier. Each consultant has a widget displaying a weekly summary.   Widget Steps to add Widget  1. Long press on blank space on mobile.  2. Select CRYSTAL Widget from the list.  3. Select branch name.  4. Select consultant's name.   Widget Details  Each day has three rows: 1st - Total appointments available. 2nd - Appointments booked. 3rd - Patients issued tokens at the clinic.   Home-Screen Page Details  Displays branch name, today’s date, patient search, doctor selection, available appointment slots, and pending appointments.   Create New Appointment  Before creating an appointment, ensure the correct branch, doctor, month, and date are selected.   Select Existing Patient  Search for an existing patient using their mobile number, Aadhaar number, first name, or last name.   Create New Patient (Patient Registration - on the fly)  Enter the full name and mobile number. Avoid initials and special characters.   Send SMS/b>  Cancel an Appointment Appointment Patient Details in Crystal App  Appointment details are visible when searching for the patient by name or mobile number.   Extended Menu views

docs.title: Billing and Receipt Generation Steps
docs.text:
Follow these steps for Billing and Receipt generation

Table of content Billing Page Details Select the bill Select required token, From the navigation window, press the BILLING button. Billing Page Overview This is the billing page. It shows all bills generated to date. Bill status can be Paid, Unpaid, Advance, or Adjusted. Bill Page Details Patient and bill details include branch name, bill book, bill number, bill date, doctor name, bill-to details, bill type, eye selection, and remarks. Bill Generation Steps Adding Items to Bill Select ADD ITEMS to add charges. Choose items from the drop-down menu and confirm selection. Editing and Deleting Items Update quantity, rate, discount, and taxes. Set quantity to zero to remove an item. Receipt Generation Receipt Generation Once payment is made, press ADD RECEIPT. Multiple receipts can be generated per bill. Ad-hoc Transactions Ad-hoc payments are advances or prepayments that can be refunded or adjusted against the final bill. Finalizing Ad-hoc Payments Once the final bill is created, ad-hoc payments are adjusted, and any excess amount is refunded.

docs.title: Inventory Module
docs.text: Table of content Inventory Page   From the home screen, select the Menu icon. Then, select Material Transactions and choose the required date.  Adding Inventory   Click the ADD button and fill in the details. To add more records, click ADD again.  Consuming Inventory   To consume inventory, click on a token, select MATERIALS, add the required material, and enter the details.  Billing for Consumed Inventory   Click on a token, select BILLING, and in the items section, click MATERIALS to add consumed items to the bill.  Stock Summary   Select Stock Summary from the menu to view stock details, including opening stock, inward stock, and closing stock.  >Detailed Stock Summary   Click on Opening Stock, Inward, or Outward Stock to view respective stock entries and reorder requirements.

docs.title: Surgery Module
docs.text: Table of content Adding Patient to Surgery List   Select the required token, press the TRUEDOCS button, then press SX POST. Choose the surgery branch and select a surgery date.  Checking Surgery List   Select the Menu icon, then Surgery List. Choose a date to view all surgeries scheduled for that day.  Rescheduling Surgery   Click the RESCHEDULE button, choose a branch, and select the new surgery date.  Accessing TrueDocs Page   Press the TrueDocs button to navigate to the TrueDocs page.  Surgery List Details   View surgery details, consultant name, patient ID, surgery order number, and anaesthetist name.  Printing Surgery List   Select the date, tick required reports, and press Generate to print the list.  Removing a Patient from Surgery List   Swipe left or right on a patient entry to remove them. Press UN-CANCEL to undo.

docs.title: TrueDocs
docs.text: TrueDocs    Paper form has been used for a long time to maintain patient records.   CrystalEMR TrueDocs provides a similar experience digitally, allowing better focus on patient care.  TrueDocs - Various Types   Examples: Case Sheet, Consultation Notes, Pre-Op Sheet, Anaesthesia Notes, Surgery Notes, Post-Op Sheet, etc.  Adding a TrueDoc    Users can create new TrueDocs for various documentation purposes.  TrueDocs - Data Entry    1. Open TrueDoc   2. Click on any field   3. Enter details or select from a dropdown   4. Navigate fields using the Next button   5. Save details using the Save button    TrueDocs - Digital Pen Entry    - Press and hold the digital pen button and tap the desired field   - Write using Thin Pen or Handwriting-to-Text mode    TrueDocs - Menu Options    Long press a TrueDoc to access extended menu options, print reports, or capture images.    TrueDocs - Viewing Previous Visits    Long press anywhere on the screen to view previous visit values.    TrueDocs - Save Options    Documents saving options.    TrueDocs - Printing Reports    Users can generate Spectacle Prescriptions, Medicine Prescriptions (English & Regional), and other reports.    TrueDocs - Discharge Summary Reports TrueDocs - Deleting and Transferring    Long-press on a TrueDoc to delete or transfer it between documents.    TrueDocs - Stage Sequence    This feature provides a logical sequence of patient visits in the clinic.    TrueDocs - Sending via WhatsApp    Users can send documents via WhatsApp by selecting templates and sending them directly. (Requires third-party integration.)  TrueDocs - Managing Events    Events such as surgeries can be saved and viewed in the Events page for quick reference.    TrueDocs - Task Management    Follow-ups and tasks can be generated from TrueDocs and viewed at the token level.    TrueDocs - Attaching Images    Users can attach images at various stages of the patient’s journey.    Post a patient to Surgery List    Follow the steps to add a patient to the surgery list and print the schedule.     Various Surgery List Options
